The '''Cressus Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] outside of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It traveled from its junction with the [[Vagaari Corridor]] at [[Kinoss/Legends|Kinoss]] to the [[Bogo Rai system/Legends|Bogo Rai system]] where the Chiss Ascendancy fought the [[Battle of Bogo Rai]], and continued on into deep space.
